findings.summary: Interface deps (Boost::assert, Boost::config, Boost::throw_exception) silently dropped from cc_library
findings.evidence: CMakeLists.txt:15-19 calls target_link_libraries(boost_core INTERFACE Boost::assert Boost::config Boost::throw_exception). The Bazel cc_library at elements/boost-core/BUILD.bazel has no deps attribute at all — these three transitive interface deps are silently absent. Any consumer that transitively includes headers from assert/config/throw_exception will fail to find their include paths through the Bazel dep graph.

findings.summary: All 9 explicit boost_test(TYPE run) targets are missing — no cc_test targets exist anywhere in the converted output
findings.evidence: test/CMakeLists.txt:13-39 defines nine explicit boost_test(TYPE run SOURCES ...) targets: no_exceptions_support_test.cpp, sv_conversion_test2.cpp, sv_hash_test.cpp, fclose_deleter_test.cpp, serialization_nvp_test.cpp, serialization_split_free_test.cpp, serialization_split_member_test.cpp, serialization_construct_data_test.cpp, yield_prim_pthread_cancel_test.cpp. The Bazel output (elements/boost-core/BUILD.bazel) contains only a cc_library and an alias — zero cc_test targets.

findings.summary: THREADS_PREFER_PTHREAD_FLAG / Threads::Threads link requirement for yield_prim_pthread_cancel_test is silently lost
findings.evidence: test/CMakeLists.txt:34-39 sets THREADS_PREFER_PTHREAD_FLAG ON, calls find_package(Threads REQUIRED), and links yield_prim_pthread_cancel_test.cpp against Threads::Threads. This is a distinct pthread linkage intent beyond simply listing the source file — in Bazel it requires linkopts=["-lpthread"] or a system dep. Even if the cc_test target were added (finding #2), the explicit pthread linkage requirement would be missed without this.

findings.summary: Jamfile.v2 test suite (481 lines, many tests) referenced by boost_test_jamfile is entirely absent from Bazel output
findings.evidence: test/CMakeLists.txt:9 calls boost_test_jamfile(FILE Jamfile.v2 LINK_LIBRARIES Boost::core Boost::static_assert Boost::type_traits). test/Jamfile.v2 is 481 lines and defines a large set of compile/run tests with per-target flags (CPP11 requirements, pedantic-errors, warnings-as-errors). No Bazel cc_test targets correspond to any of these.

findings.summary: Swap test subdirectory (22 source files, Jamfile.v2) is unconditionally added but has no Bazel targets
findings.evidence: test/CMakeLists.txt:43 calls add_subdirectory(swap) unconditionally (outside the HAVE_BOOST_TEST guard). test/swap/ contains 22 .cpp test files and a Jamfile.v2 that compiles/runs them all (test/swap/CMakeLists.txt:9 invokes boost_test_jamfile(FILE Jamfile.v2 LINK_LIBRARIES Boost::core)). No cc_test targets exist for any swap test.

findings.summary: quick.cpp consumer integration test is missing — both cmake_install_test and cmake_subdir_test build and run it, but no Bazel cc_test equivalent exists
findings.evidence: test/cmake_install_test/CMakeLists.txt:11-15 and test/cmake_subdir_test/CMakeLists.txt:14-18 each build test/quick.cpp as add_executable(quick) linked against Boost::core and register it as a ctest. quick.cpp (#include boost/core/addressof.hpp, checked_delete.hpp, and 20 other headers, int main(){}) is a smoke test verifying a consumer can include and link the full library. No Bazel cc_test for quick.cpp exists anywhere in the converted output.
